title: getCounters request
description: GET /v1/counters - request. Counters of the caller's firm per product (pending, declined, verifying).
$comment: Source: DISENO S7 (d) GetCountersQuery, (e); S3 (e) GET /v1/firms/{firmId}/counters; PRD RF-031, RF-037. Audience: PUBLIC (served to the UI) - SX-01a family caller. Residency: REGIONAL (cell of the firm, resolved by the stateless global edge firmId -> cell, RF-093); the firm comes from the authenticated context, never from the URL. Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: none (bounded per product).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
